caption:
typing macros is a hobby. describing lunch is a sentence

#wellnesstips #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
I described lunch in
*one sentence*

It did the maths

"White fish, rice, salad
with olive oil"

That's the whole log

517 kcal, 52 g protein

Parsed, not typed

Eating out isn't
a spreadsheet problem

It's one sentence

slides.heading: Log meals in your words
slides.body: Tell SOMA what you ate the way you'd tell a friend — it does the numbers and keeps the day honest
